# Buyer Quirk Sheet: Mogale City Local Municipality

**Buyer:** Mogale City Local Municipality (Krugersdorp, Gauteng, West Rand District)
**Kind:** Municipality
**Packs sampled:** 10 — ocds-9t57fa-165755 (landscape maintenance equipment supply, IEM(BM)01/2027), ocds-9t57fa-164989 (auctioneering services, F(B&T)01-2027), ocds-9t57fa-165551 / 165539 / 165538 / 165541 / 165542 / 165540 / 165552 / 165546 (single training-panel tender CORP(L&D)01/2027, issued as 8 near-identical category lots: Category 6 Technical/Engineering/Operational, Category 2 Management, Category 1 Leadership/Governance, Category 4 HR, Category 5 Communication/Stakeholder, Category 3 Financial Management, Category 9 Economic Development, Category 8 IT/Systems)
**Date:** 2026-08

Note on sample composition: the 8 CORP(L&D) packs share one boilerplate template (only the category title, functionality weighting numbers and scope differ), so most rules below are effectively drawn from 3 independent boilerplate sets (IEM(BM), F(B&T), CORP(L&D)) rather than 10.

---

## Submission channel & rules

Bid-box only. All three boilerplate sets state bids "MAY BE DEPOSITED IN THE BID BOX SITUATED AT" the Mogale City Civic Centre, Cnr Commissioner & Market Street, Krugersdorp — "Bid boxes are situated at the reception desk of the Supply Chain Management Unit, situated on the upper level of the West Wing of the Mogale City Civic Centre" (ocds-9t57fa-165755). The e-tender portal (www.etenders.gov.za / www.mogalecity.gov.za) is document-collection only, never a submission channel: "Tender documents may be downloaded from the e-tender portal at www.etenders.gov.za as well as..." (ocds-9t57fa-165755, ocds-9t57fa-164989, ocds-9t57fa-165551) — no mention anywhere of uploading a bid there.

Hard-copy governs, with unusually strict paper-formality rules layered on top of the box requirement:
- "No late tender will be accepted." (ocds-9t57fa-165755, cl.21; ocds-9t57fa-164989, cl.20; ocds-9t57fa-165551, cl.19)
- "Telefax or e-mail bids will not be accepted." (ocds-9t57fa-165755, cl.22 — same wording in all three sets)
- "No electronic signature will be accepted in the bidding document. The bidder's signature must always be signed by hand in black ink." (ocds-9t57fa-165755, cl.20)
- "All bids must be submitted on the official and original forms and must not be retyped or typed or scanned." (ocds-9t57fa-165755, cl.23)
- "Bids must be completed in black ink, handwritten and must not be typed." (ocds-9t57fa-165755, cl.24)
- "The use of Tipp-Ex is not allowed on the bid documents." (ocds-9t57fa-165755, cl.25)
- "Bids completed in pencil will be regarded as invalid bids." (ocds-9t57fa-165755, cl.26; also "Bids completed in pencil or any erasable pen will be regarded as invalid" at cl.6 preamble)
- "No page(s) must be removed from the original tender document." (ocds-9t57fa-165755, cl.27)
- Sealing/opening: "Requirements for sealing, addressing, delivery, opening and assessment of bids are stated in the tender document" (ocds-9t57fa-165755, cl.28) — points to the standard MBD instructions rather than a bespoke label format; no envelope-marking template observed in sampled text.
- Bids opened "immediately after the closing date and time in a venue to be indicated" (ocds-9t57fa-165755, cl.36).

## Municipal-arrears / rates clause

Window: not older than 90 days, and must show no arrears as at closing date. "The bidding entity and its director(s) must submit Municipal Rates and Taxes account which is not older than three (3) months / ninety (90) days and must not be in arrears at the time of the closing date." (ocds-9t57fa-165755, item 8; identical wording in ocds-9t57fa-164989 item 9 and ocds-9t57fa-165551 item 6).

Who it covers: the bidding entity AND every director/member/partner individually, not just the company — reinforced by MBD 4/declaration language ("Does the bidder or any of its directors owe any municipal rates and taxes ... in arrears for more than three months?" pattern echoed via the "Declaration: Certificate for Municipal Services" form requiring "ATTACH COPY OF MUNICIPAL ACCOUNT(S) OF ALL THE DIRECTOR/S NOT OLDER THAN 90 DAYS") (ocds-9t57fa-165755, p.13).

Distinctive elaboration — Mogale City provides an unusually long fallback chain for bidders/directors who cannot produce a municipal account, all in item 9–15 of the mandatory-returnables list (ocds-9t57fa-165755): no owned property → valid lease/rental statement (item 9); informal settlement/rural, no rates account → councillor/tribal-authority letterhead confirmation stamped by the municipality's human-settlement division that the address receives no municipal services (item 10); living at parents' place / not responsible for the account → sworn affidavit from the property owner, or a sworn affidavit explaining why the owner can't provide one (item 11); property in transfer → conveyancing attorney's letter (item 12); account in a Trust's name → sworn affidavit from the Trustee(s) (item 13); account in a spouse's name → joint sworn affidavit from both director and spouse (item 14); property benefiting from the municipal indigent-support programme → sworn affidavit declaring that status (item 15). This granular substitute-documentation ladder was not seen at this level of detail elsewhere in the sample and is a strong buyer fingerprint.

## B-BBEE treatment

Preference points only, not a hard gate. The MBD1 cover page ties the B-BBEE certificate/sworn affidavit explicitly to points eligibility: "[A B-BBEE STATUS LEVEL VERIFICATION CERTIFICATE/ SWORN AFFIDAVIT (FOR EMES & QSEs) MUST BE SUBMITTED IN ORDER TO QUALIFY FOR PREFERENCE POINTS FOR B-BBEE]" (ocds-9t57fa-165755) — framed as a condition of scoring, not of bid validity, and B-BBEE certificates do not appear on the "Mandatory Documents" instant-disqualification list.

Specific goals (PPPFA 2022, 80/20 or 90/10 system, 20/10 pts): Mogale City replaces/supplements the generic B-BBEE goal with an explicit local-geography preference ladder verified against the same municipal-account documentation used for the arrears clause — "Within the boundaries of the municipality (Municipal account/lease agreement/rental statement will be utilised to verify the area of jurisdiction of the bidder) x 5" / "Outside the boundaries of the Municipality, but within the West Rand District Municipality... x 3" / "Within the boundaries of Gauteng Province x 2" / "Outside the boundaries of Gauteng Province ... x 0", plus "Gender (Women-owned enterprise) ... x 5" (CSD-verified) and "Youth Enterprise (enterprises owned by persons younger than 35 years) ... x 5" (CSD-verified) (ocds-9t57fa-165755, pp.7–8). This local-geography-first specific-goals table is a distinctive Mogale City feature.

## Cure/condonation policy

No cure or condonation clause observed for missing mandatory documents. The returnables list is split into two hard tiers with no remediation path stated in any sampled pack: "A. MANDATORY DOCUMENTS (IF NOT PROVIDED, THE BID WILL BE INSTANTLY DISQUALIFIED)" followed by "FAILURE TO ADHERE TO ANY OF THE ABOVE WILL RESULT IN THE BID NOT BEING EVALUATED FURTHER" (ocds-9t57fa-165755, ocds-9t57fa-164989 item A, ocds-9t57fa-165551 item A — identical heading in all three sets), and "B. ESSENTIAL DOCUMENTS (NO AWARD WILL BE MADE IF ANY OF THE INFORMATION/DOCUMENTATION LISTED BELOW IS NOT COMPLIED WITH OR SUBMITTED)". Tender Conditions carry the same instant-fail framing: "(FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH THESE CONDITIONS SHALL RESULT IN DISQUALIFICATION)" (ocds-9t57fa-165755). No "may be condoned," "administrative error," or post-submission clarification-request language for missing forms was found in any sampled pack — only a generic pre-bid "technical clarification queries" channel before closing (ocds-9t57fa-165755, ocds-9t57fa-164989). Functionality scoring has its own zero-tolerance sub-rule (see Functionality norms) that likewise forecloses partial credit. Treat this buyer as strict/non-curable based on sampled text; "Not observed" should not be read as "cure is allowed" — the pattern points the other way.

## Security/vetting requirements

Not observed in sampled packs. No mention of post-award vetting, integrity pacts, security clearance, lifestyle audits, or POPIA consent forms in any of the three boilerplate sets searched (ocds-9t57fa-165755, ocds-9t57fa-164989, ocds-9t57fa-165551). Standard MBD 4 (Declaration of Interest), MBD 8 (past SCM practice) and MBD 9 (Certificate of Independent Bid Determination) are required as essential documents, which is generic National Treasury practice rather than a buyer-specific vetting regime.

## Financial demands

Performance security follows the generic National Treasury General Conditions of Contract boilerplate rather than a bespoke Mogale City figure: "Within thirty (30) days of receipt of the notification of contract award, the successful bidder shall furnish to the purchaser the performance security of the amount specified in SCC," acceptable as "(a) a bank guarantee or an irrevocable letter of credit issued by a reputable bank... or (b) a cashier's or certified cheque" (ocds-9t57fa-165755, GCC cl.7; identical text in ocds-9t57fa-164989 and ocds-9t57fa-165551). No sampled pack's SCC/pricing schedule stated a concrete guarantee percentage. Insurance clause is likewise the stock GCC line ("goods supplied under the contract shall be fully insured... against loss or damage") with no Mogale-specific sum insured. In the auctioneering tender specifically, the appointed Auctioneer must self-provide surety over cash handled: "The Auctioneer commits and binds himself by means of a surety for all the money collected at the auctions and will remain responsible for all the proceeds from the auctions" (ocds-9t57fa-164989, item 9.1) — a service-specific requirement, not a general buyer policy. No bank confirmation letters, credit ratings, or audited-financial-statement thresholds were found in any sampled pack — "Not observed in sampled packs."

## Functionality norms

Two-stage gate (functionality pass/fail before an 80/20 or 90/10 price/goals score), but the weighting and pass mark vary per tender rather than following one fixed municipal norm:
- Landscape equipment supply: "Functionality evaluation criteria of 30 points, of which the service provider is required to score a minimum of 15 points" — a 50% pass mark (ocds-9t57fa-165755).
- Auctioneering services: "Functionality evaluation criteria of 40 points of which the service provider is required to score the minimum of 29 points" — a ~72.5% pass mark (ocds-9t57fa-164989).
- Training panel (Category 6): "Functionality evaluation criteria of 65 points of which the service provider is required to score a minimum of 36 points in order to be appointed into a panel" — a ~55% pass mark (ocds-9t57fa-165551).

Distinctive scoring rule present in at least the equipment and training packs: zero on any single criterion or sub-criterion is an automatic kill regardless of the overall total — "A score of zero (0) in any criterion will result in automatic disqualification, even if the minimum or maximum score threshold is met" and "A score of zero (0) in any sub-criterion will lead to the disqualification of the bidder, regardless of the total or minimum points" (ocds-9t57fa-165755; near-identical text at ocds-9t57fa-165551, cl.8.5–8.6). Not confirmed verbatim in the auctioneering pack (ocds-9t57fa-164989) — its functionality section did not surface the same "score of zero" phrase in the sampled text, so treat as likely-but-unconfirmed there.

## Distinctive kill rules / quirks

1. **Handwritten-only, black-ink-only bid documents.** MBD forms "must not be re-typed or scanned or completed electronically... must be completed in black ink, handwritten," Tipp-Ex is banned, pencil or "any erasable pen" invalidates the bid, and electronic signatures are rejected outright (ocds-9t57fa-165755, cl.6/20/23–26). This is a far stricter formality regime than a simple "no faxed/emailed bids" rule and would trip up bidders used to typed/printed MBD packs.
2. **Two-tier fatal-defect structure**, explicitly labelled "MANDATORY DOCUMENTS (IF NOT PROVIDED, THE BID WILL BE INSTANTLY DISQUALIFIED)" vs "ESSENTIAL DOCUMENTS (NO AWARD WILL BE MADE IF ... NOT COMPLIED WITH)" — a named severity split rather than one flat non-responsive/responsive line (ocds-9t57fa-165755, ocds-9t57fa-164989, ocds-9t57fa-165551).
3. **Compulsory briefing attendance register is a hard gate**: "No bids will be considered from bidders who did not attend the Compulsory Briefing Session and complete the attendance register" (ocds-9t57fa-165755, item 4).
4. **Local-geography preference ladder** under PPPFA "specific goals," using the same municipal-account/lease evidence as the arrears clause to score 5/3/2/0 points by proximity to Mogale City → West Rand District → Gauteng Province → outside Gauteng (ocds-9t57fa-165755, pp.7–8) — an unusually granular, evidence-linked local-preference design.
5. **Extended arrears fallback-documentation ladder** covering informal-settlement residents, indigent-programme beneficiaries, trust-held accounts, spousal accounts, and property-in-transfer, each requiring its own sworn affidavit or third-party letter (ocds-9t57fa-165755, items 9–15) — see Municipal-arrears section.
6. **Grievance channel is itself procedural**: an aggrieved bidder must lodge "a written objection or complaint to the municipality" within 14 days of the decision, via email to SCMEnquiries@mogalecity.gov.za (ocds-9t57fa-165755, cl.38) — the only place email correspondence is explicitly invited, in contrast to the flat ban on emailed bid submissions.
